description: Foul Sewer House Connections Delivered and Total Foul Sewer Network Constructed is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ashghal. This dataset provides information about the foul sewer house connections delivered and the total foul sewer network constructed by the Public Works Authority (Ashghal) as part of its infrastructure development projects across Qatar. Connections are broken down by the delivering division (DNPD and RPD). Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ashghal. Its tags are Foul Sewer Network, Foul Sewer Infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
